title: Astra Superstars
native_title: アストラ・スーパースターズ
overview:
Mid-air head-to-head slugfest action

In the beautiful world called Astra World, the battle over the "Lucky Star" begins now!

Astra Superstars is a fighting game in which every bout takes place in the sky. Fighters float in mid-air and can rise above or swoop beneath each other, dash at any height and slip behind an opponent. Choose from a colorful cast that includes Lettuce, Coco and Rufe, and fight best-of-three rounds.

There are no special-move commands to memorize: light, medium and heavy buttons do the work, and heavy hits send foes bouncing off the edges of the screen. Fill the Star Rank meter to store up to three stocks and spend them on flashy Star Specials.

- 1 or 2 players
- Works with the console alone; the Extended RAM Cartridge 4MB shortens load times
- Memory backup

空中対戦ボコスカアクション

アストラワールドという美しい世界を舞台に"ラッキースター"をめぐる戦いが今始まる!
